title: Minimax Frontier for Buy-and-Hold Wealth Effects in Event Studies with Generated Event Proxies
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the delivered package incremental with paper-score ceiling 5.6 below the field floor 7.4 and found it not salvageable in scope because lower witnesses are not uniform over boundary-tight envelopes.
gap_reasons: The proofs repeatedly assert that carrier-plus-bump perturbations can be scaled to preserve the Holder, bounded-response, and two-sided-modulus envelopes, although nonemptiness and B>D^2 provide no interior slack in those envelopes; for example, c_mod=C_mod is allowed.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery constructed event-transport identification, estimator upper bounds, exact conditional coverage, an iid-versus-beta-mixing dependence elbow, and a universal shared-design obstruction. The matching lower-frontier claims collapsed because their bump witnesses were not shown to remain inside boundary-tight Holder, response, and two-sided-modulus envelopes; the banked artifact therefore preserves an open uniformity defect and must not be treated as a sound proof of those converses. A future attempt must either build boundary-compatible witnesses or state and justify primitive uniform interior slack before reasserting the beta/iid matching frontiers.
tldr: The target is the cohort-weighted finite-cohort causal buy-and-hold level-wealth effect at a realized event path.  Consistency and cohort-average event transport identify it through historical conditional-mean surfaces.  The original class nevertheless permits one design-shared event shock to survive arbitrarily many unit replicates: an explicit two-completion witness gives fixed positive minimax-risk and uniformly honest expected-length lower bounds while \(R_{\star,\beta}\to0\).  The witness satisfies historical full-design centering and violates event full-design mean stability, so at least the event-side restriction is rate-essential; it does not prove separate necessity of the historical restriction.  On the full-design-centered class, nonemptiness requires \(B\ge D^2\).  Under design-only geometric beta mixing, matching strict-slack bounds give conditional mean-squared-error rate \(R_{\star,\beta}\) and honest expected-length rate \(R_{\star,\beta}^{1/2}\), including the unavoidable log-spacing term.  On the named conditionally independent-calendar subclass, the iid-tuned estimator and interval replace that term by \(R_{\mathrm{sp}}=T^{-2\lambda/d}\), giving the sharp no-log rates \(R_\star\) and \(R_\star^{1/2}\).  Exact finite-sample conditional coverage holds in both restricted regimes.  At \(B=D^2\), the same upper bounds remain valid but no universal donor converse is asserted.
gap: Causal financial event-study theory treats mainly linear return contrasts, repeated-measurement regression fixes the query, generated-regressor theory moves every training coordinate, and synthetic-control intervals do not derive a generated-proxy minimax frontier for compounded wealth.
fill: The project places finite-cohort identification under maintained cross-date average transport, an exact raw-estimator weighted-panel coefficient representation, estimation, conditional inference, and every least-favorable channel inside a single joint panel-law class. It derives the arbitrary-growth phase diagram, proves higher-smoothness donor saturation, and constructs a total covariance-aware local-polynomial interval with retained-block, event, and donor uncertainty calibrated separately.
